description: NaGd₃Ti₂(SbO₇)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with six GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.70 Å. There are three inequivalent Gd sites. In the first Gd site, Gd is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.72 Å. In the second Gd site, Gd is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four SbO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.59 Å. In the third Gd site, Gd is bonded to eight O atoms to form distorted GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four TiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.22-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with six GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-47°. There are two shorter (1.95 Å) and four longer (1.99 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four SbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-45°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.02 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-48°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.02 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₈ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four GdO₈ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-48°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.98-2.03 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Gd atoms to form ONaGd₃ tetrahedra that share corners with six ONaGd₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaGdTiSb trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaGdSb₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaGdTiSb trigonal pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Gd and two Ti atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Gd, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Gd, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Gd, one Ti, and one Sb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Gd, one Ti, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONaGdTiSb trigonal pyramids that share corners with four ONaGd₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaGdTiSb trigonal pyramids, edges with two ONaGd₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaGdTiSb trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Gd, and two Sb atoms to form distorted ONaGdSb₂ tetrahedra that share corners with four ONaGd₃ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONaGdTiSb trigonal pyramids, edges with two ONaGd₃ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaGdTiSb trigonal pyramid.
